about.title: Central Tiffin Room: A Century of Unchanging Taste
about.paragraph1: Central Tiffin Room, fondly known as CTR, is more than just an eatery; it's a living legend deeply steeped in the hearts and history of Old Bengaluru. Established in 1920, **Central Tiffin Room** has spent over a century delighting generations with iconic Dosas, Idlis, and a variety of South Indian delicacies that remain timeless favorites among people of all ages. Our rich legacy, envisioned by the visionary Subramanyam brothers and now carried forward by the 3rd Generation, including Mr. Sandesh Poojari and Ganesh S Poojari, truly embodies culinary mastery and cherished tradition.
about.paragraph2: At **Central Tiffin Room**, we pride ourselves on serving 'Bengaluru’s Best Benne Dose,' an experience that truly is the emotion holding Old Bengaluru together. For 104 years, we have cast our vintage charm, delivering the most delicious Benne Doses while meticulously retaining their original taste and quality. This enduring commitment is a direct reflection of the boundless love and support our patrons have showered upon us for over a century, making every bite an essence of nostalgia.
